critical_checks.attainment: Q001 supplies a feasible mean with lower comparisons against every image member; Q002 identifies sInf. Together they establish actual minimum on bounded prefixes, including empty prefix. sInf symbol alone never used as attainment evidence.
critical_checks.uniqueness: Not encoded by Q001/Q002. Existing separately named positive-horizon empiricalMean_unique provides reusable uniqueness. Combining it with Q001 yields the expected unique interval minimizer for T>0. No uniqueness at T=0 and no new uniqueness theorem credited to these six anchors.
critical_checks.signedness: D3 can be -1/2 for fixed y=(0,1),prediction=(0,1),T=2. This is an algebraic fixed-trace example, not the D1 learner.
critical_checks.actual_strategy: Q005/Q006 substitute D1 y, whose formula uses y_0..y_(t-1) only; Q003/Q004 generic traces do not establish performance or causality.
critical_checks.expected_minimum: No expectation in packet. E[min hindsight loss] and min E[fixed loss] remain distinct obligations.
critical_checks.definition_totality: D0 and D3 are literal formulas, not choice-based optimizer definitions. Their wider/empty domain is disclosed. No hidden default branch is being called a unique source optimizer.

supplemental_existing_uniqueness.header:
theorem empiricalMean_unique (y : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (u : ℝ)
    (hu : (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, (u-y t)^2) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, (empiricalMean y n-y t)^2) :
    u = empiricalMean y n
